methodology: Same frozen source pixels, production automatic fitter and ten-second fitting budget. Automatic track supplies rough collage ROIs only and whole individual photos; fixed track supplies disputed historical corners/insets. Different crops produce different classified targets, so error percentages are not paired estimates against one ground truth. Numeric candidate checks include original-source regions and guarded paper support; a pass does not establish artistic accuracy, correct cropping, published cutting paths or physical assembly. Full inventory includes 15 clipped and one obscured instance, outside the 31-complete-motif denominator.
